Cinematic wide-format cover illustration for "Building Reliable AI Agents", subtitled "Patterns for production".
Theme: AI agents, API gateways, microservices.
Visual approach: abstract geometric with clean modern lines.
Composition: strong central focal point, negative space in upper third for text overlay.
Color palette: deep navy transitioning to electric blue with warm amber accents.
Atmosphere: professional, aspirational, forward-looking, modern and aspirational sensibility.
Inspired by the article's core concepts, 
create a visually striking hero image with dramatic volumetric lighting,
fine detail textures, and cinematic depth of field.
Magazine-quality digital art with strong visual hierarchy., 8K, ultra-high-quality, masterpiece, cinematic composition, rule of thirds, volumetric lighting, dramatic shadows, fine detail textures, professional color grading, cute kawaii aesthetic, pastel colors, rounded shapes, soft gradients, playful design, sweet and gentle, no sharp edges, bubbly composition
